en.title: Requiem of Silver Light: The Seven Lost Chants and the Archive of Oblivion
en.premise: Ruling the world is the remnant of the 'Genesis Melody,' said to have once been played by the gods. In a world losing its sound and being eroded by a disease called silence, a young man who picks up the forbidden receiver known as the 'Dawn Radio' is guided to the 'Archive of Oblivion' sleeping deep beneath the earth. This is a journey of despair and rebirth to gather the seven lost chants and summon back the dawn to a frozen world.

zh.title: 银明安魂曲 ―七首失落的咏唱与忘却书库―
zh.premise: 主宰这个世界的，是据传曾由诸神奏响的“创世旋律”的残渣。在一个失去声音、并被名为寂静的疾病不断侵蚀的世界里，捡到禁忌接收器“拂晓收音机”的青年，被引导至沉睡于地底的“忘却书库”。这是一段集齐七首失落的咏唱、为冻结的世界再次唤回拂晓的绝望与再生之旅。
